rationale: We can synthetically reproduce the key mechanism: a large issues table scanned in PK order due to a leading-wildcard LIKE, with correlated/EXISTS checks and OR predicates inflating per-row cost. Exact 15-second runtime depends on hardware and version. MySQL may materialize the NOT IN members subquery; this still demonstrates per-row probing overhead and aligns with the symptomatic plan shape.
